audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-008: Is RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN globally unique and collision-free across all protocol contexts?
audit_items.skip_reason: SPECIFICATION-ONLY: The RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN constant is defined in the consensus specification as b'RCKZGCBATCH__V1_'. Prysm delegates all KZG batch verification operations to the c-kzg-4844 library. Domain separator uniqueness and collision-resistance are cryptographic design properties of the specification itself, not implementation bugs in Prysm. This check belongs in consensus spec formal verification, not client implementation auditing.
audit_items.notes: The specification defines RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN = b'RCKZGCBATCH__V1_' in specrefs/constants.yml line 498. Prysm uses c-kzg-4844 library bindings in beacon-chain/blockchain/kzg/kzg.go which delegates all cryptographic operations to the external library. Domain separator analysis is a specification-level concern.

audit_items.skip_reason: SPECIFICATION-ONLY: The computation of RLC (commitment component), RLI (interpolation component), and RLP (proof component) in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl is performed by the c-kzg-4844 library, not by Prysm.
